items.name: 食蚊鱼
items.form: an elongated body, a short broad head, a short snout, large eyes, an upward-pointing mouth, no barbels
items.fins: small pectoral and pelvic fins, the pelvic fins set very close to the anal fin, a large dorsal fin, a large rounded tail fin

items.name: 塘鳢
items.form: an elongated stout body, a large broad flat head, a wide short snout

items.name: 黄颡鱼
items.form: a large flat head, a short snout, a downward-pointing mouth, four pairs of barbels, naked skin

items.name: 小鲤鱼
items.form: a deep body, a slightly arched back, a moderate-sized head, a short blunt snout, a mouth at the front of the head, two pairs of barbels
items.fins: a long dorsal fin with a stout serrated spine, a deeply forked tail fin

items.name: 金鲫
items.form: a deep spindle-shaped body
items.fins: pelvic fins set slightly ahead of the dorsal fin origin, pelvic fins similar in shape to the pectoral fins, a deeply forked tail fin with rounded lobe tips

items.name: 老塘草鱼
items.form: an elongated body, a rounded belly, no keel along the belly, a broad medium-sized head, a short blunt snout

items.name: 圆尾斗鱼
items.fins: long large dorsal and anal fins, pelvic fins set below the pectoral region, a rounded tail fin

items.name: 塘主的大青鱼
items.form: an elongated body, a rounded belly, no keel along the belly, a broad blunt head, a mouth at the front of the head, no barbels
items.fins: a long dorsal fin with no spines, a forked tail fin

items.name: 深海鳕
items.form: an elongated body tapering to a slim tail stock, a large head, a blunt snout, a small barbel under the chin
items.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two anal fins, a slightly forked tail fin

items.name: 灯笼鱼
items.form: a slender elongated body, a large head, a large eye, a mouth at the front of the head
items.fins: a dorsal fin, a forked tail fin

items.name: 鼬鳚
items.form: an elongated eel-like body, a tapering tail, a small head, a blunt snout, small eyes, a mouth at the front of the head
items.fins: a long dorsal fin, a long anal fin, the dorsal and anal fins joined continuously to the tail fin, pelvic fins set far forward under the throat

items.name: 帆蜥鱼
items.form: a slender elongated ribbon-shaped body, a large head, a large mouth, a deep mouth cleft, large canine teeth, a short snout
items.fins: a long high sail-like dorsal fin, an anal fin, low pectoral fins with elongated spear-shaped front tips, small pelvic fins, a deeply forked tail fin with the upper lobe drawn out into filaments

items.name: 深海鲷
items.form: a deep body, a steep forehead, a small mouth at the front of the head, a large eye
items.fins: a long dorsal fin with a distinct spiny front section, a short anal fin, a forked tail fin

items.name: 黑叉齿鱼
items.form: an elongated slender body, a large head, a very large mouth, sharp recurved teeth, naked skin, small eyes, a long tapering tail
items.fins: a long dorsal fin, a long anal fin, small pectoral fins, a forked tail fin

items.name: 尖牙鱼
items.form: a large ridged head, a body tapering sharply from behind the head to the tail, small eyes, a large mouth, sharp teeth, rough skin
items.fins: a dorsal fin with no spines, an anal fin with no spines

items.name: 后肛鱼
items.form: a short deep body shaped like an iron, tubular eyes set vertically, a small mouth, a bare head
items.fins: a dorsal fin at the rear of the back, a reduced short anal fin, pectoral fins on a stalk-like base, large pelvic fins just below the dorsal fin, a tail fin divided into upper and lower parts

items.name: 囊鳃鳗
items.form: a very elongated slender eel-like body, a short snout, the upper jaw longer than the lower, a huge sac-like mouth, the mouth cleft extending well behind the eye, long slender teeth in the jaws, naked skin
items.fins: a dorsal fin starting near the front of the body, an anal fin, pectoral fins, no pelvic fins, the tail ends of the dorsal and anal fins sometimes drawn out into filaments

items.name: 深海鳐
items.form: a diamond-shaped disc formed by the pectoral fins, a slender tail, a broad head, large spiracles behind the eyes, thorny skin
items.fins: the pectoral fins fused with the head to form the disc, small pelvic fins, a slender tail with a small fin fold

items.name: 灯塔水母
items.form: a small bell-shaped transparent body, the bell diameter and height about equal, many tentacles around the bell margin, round tentacle bulbs around the margin

items.name: 深海虾虎
items.form: an elongated slender body, a large head, a blunt snout, large eyes, a mouth at the front of the head
items.fins: two dorsal fins, the pelvic fins joined into a disc under the throat, a rounded tail fin

items.name: 无光鳕
items.form: a moderately proportioned body, a large head, a blunt snout, a small chin barbel, sensory pores along the head
items.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two anal fins, a slightly forked tail fin

items.name: 鮟鱇鱼
items.form: a large broad head, a huge mouth, backward-curved teeth, loose skin, a fishing lure on the head, gill openings behind the pectoral fins, a stout body tapering to the tail
items.fins: a dorsal fin with a lure at the front, small pectoral fins, pelvic fins set forward under the throat

items.name: 树须鱼
items.form: a short body, smooth skin, many barbels on the lower jaw branching like tree roots, a short fishing lure set behind the tip of the snout, a nearly horizontal mouth cleft, no second dorsal spine, no fleshy flap on the back
items.fins: a dorsal fin, an anal fin

items.name: 皱鳃鲨
items.form: an eel-like body, frilled gill openings along the sides, a very short snout, a wide mouth set at the front, teeth of the same shape in both jaws with long cusps, nostrils on the lower side of the head
items.fins: a small leaf-shaped dorsal fin, an anal fin larger than the dorsal fin, small paddle-shaped pectoral fins

items.name: 六鳃鲨
items.form: a long stout body, a short blunt snout, a large curved mouth, six pairs of wide gill openings set obliquely, large eyes
items.fins: an anal fin smaller than the dorsal fin, the anal fin set below the rear of the dorsal fin

items.name: 深海银鲛
items.form: an elongated tapering body, a large head with a blunt snout, large eyes, smooth skin, the gill openings covered by a single flap
items.fins: two dorsal fins with a stout spine in front, large wing-like pectoral fins, a long whip-like tail

items.name: 单棘魨
items.form: an elongated body, a small pointed head, a small mouth at the front of the head, leathery skin, a prominent dorsal spine above the eye
items.fins: a dorsal fin reduced to a single stout spine, a second dorsal fin, a small anal fin, a rounded tail fin

items.name: 皇带鱼
items.form: an elongated ribbon-like body, a horse-like head, a short blunt snout, medium-sized eyes set high and lateral near the snout, a small mouth at the front of the head slanting upward and lacking teeth on the jaws and palate, naked skin, many irregular small granular bumps along the flanks
items.fins: a single long dorsal fin, the front elongated into filaments

items.name: 巨口鲨
items.form: a large wide long blunt head, a very short snout, a huge mouth at the front of the head
items.fins: soft fins, large narrow elongated pectoral fins, a broom-shaped tail fin with a long upper lobe only slightly upturned

items.name: 格陵兰鲨
items.form: a stout heavy body, a short blunt rounded snout, small eyes, a small mouth near the tip of the snout
items.fins: small rounded pectoral fins, two small dorsal fins set far back near the tail, no anal fin, a nearly symmetrical tail fin

items.name: 小头睡鲨
items.form: a stout heavy body, a short blunt rounded snout, small eyes, a small mouth near the tip of the snout
items.fins: small rounded pectoral fins, two small dorsal fins set far back near the tail, no anal fin, a nearly symmetrical tail fin

items.name: 太平洋睡鲨
items.form: a stout body, a short conical blunt snout, the snout length about equal to the mouth width, slender long upper teeth and shorter slanted lower teeth with overlapping bases
items.fins: two small dorsal fins with no spines, pectoral fins with broad rounded tips, a short asymmetrical tail fin

items.name: 北极霞水母
items.form: a large bell-shaped body, many long trailing tentacles

items.name: 深海鳚
items.form: a slender elongated body, a blunt rounded head, a small mouth at the front of the head, large eyes set high, no barbels, naked skin
items.fins: a long continuous dorsal fin with a shallow notch, a long anal fin, small pectoral fins

items.name: 黑口鱼
items.form: teeth in several rows on both jaws
items.fins: the dorsal fin set in front of the anal fin, pectoral fins not elongated into filaments

items.name: 巨尾鱼
items.form: an elongated body of medium size, a large head, a medium-sized snout protruding at the front with the snout length about equal to the eye diameter, a large oblique mouth with the upper jaw extending below the eye and the lower jaw slightly protruding beyond the upper, tooth bands on both jaws
items.fins: a single dorsal fin in front of the middle, an anal fin base about equal to the dorsal fin base, elongated pectoral fins reaching the anus, a forked tail fin

items.name: 褶胸鱼
items.form: a small body, a straight back, a very prominent belly giving a stone-axe profile, large eyes, an upward-pointing mouth, a trunk slightly taller than long
items.fins: a posteriorly placed dorsal fin, a long forked tail fin, very large pectoral fins

items.name: 狼牙鲷
items.form: a deep body, a large head, a moderate eye, a row of exposed fangs along both jaws
items.fins: a spiny dorsal fin with stout front spines, a short anal fin with two spines, a forked tail fin

items.name: 角高体金眼鲷
items.form: a deep diamond-shaped body, a steep forehead with a short frontal crest, a very large eye, a small mouth at the front of the head
items.fins: a long spiny dorsal fin, a short anal fin, a forked tail fin

items.name: 海沟幽灵·大王乌贼
items.form: a huge body with a long mantle, long arms and two long feeding tentacles

items.name: 海沟之主·深渊巨鲨
items.form: a massive heavy body, a broad streamlined head with a short tapered snout, wide jaws lined with rows of triangular teeth, five long gill openings
items.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long swept pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin with a long upper lobe

items.name: 海沟终焉·原始巨口鲨
items.form: a massive deep body, a broad head with a short tapered snout, an enormous mouth reaching far back, small teeth in many rows, five long gill openings
items.fins: a rounded dorsal fin set far back, large swept pectoral fins, a long crescent tail fin

items.name: 星磷鱼
items.form: a slender body, a small pointed head, a large oblique mouth
items.fins: a long trailing dorsal crest, a translucent fan-shaped tail fin, slender filamentous pelvic fins
